paragraphs: Rav Yitzḥak bar Abba bar Maḥasya and Rav Ḥananel were sitting, etc.; he raises an objection, etc.; they went up to Rav's house. And Shimon bar Ḥuna, in Rav's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 6, mishnah 6. He and Rav Ḥananel before Rav, there in Megillah, chapter 2, halakhah 2.
